title: MiniMax cloud via BYO key - the API-only 2K finisher, and optional full cloud generation
description: Local H3 tears because the VAE averages motion inside 17-frame groups; more canvas cannot fix it. MiniMax's 768p->2K regeneration is API-only, takes an arbitrary uploaded video, and costs 0.05 USD/s. Research + ToS done, nothing built, no tests run.
